limitations: Public model catalog entries do not prove availability to the user's account; no key, login, API model listing, token exchange, or inference was used.
Layer version1 cannot express separate maximum input limits; fetched values are retained per model in this provenance and context/output limits remain distinct.
Quotes represent standard processing, excluding regional premiums, service tiers, Batch/Flex/Fast discounts or uplifts, and built-in tool fees.
GPT-5.6 Sol promotional standard rates are documented through at least 2026-11-21; this dated snapshot is not a perpetual price guarantee.
Audio output, hosted tools, pro mode, asynchronous orchestration, multi-agent execution and steering are outside the version 1 catalog profile. Their omission does not assert provider unavailability.

The Markdown latest-model.md endpoint ignores the model query in collected variants; those guidance-* MD receipts are retained as retrieval evidence and are not used for older-family claims. Correct selected HTML guides are used where needed.
Existing native o3/gpt-5.4/gpt-6-astra objects are intentionally preserved; discrepancies in optional existing sampling metadata are not silently amended in this extension proposal.

field_corrections.reason: Current official model overview explicitly rejects custom sampling regardless of thinking.
Native ordinary API limit is 200K; no unrequested beta entitlement or routing assumed.
Make both custom-sampling guards explicit, preserving reviewed compatibility.temperature=false.
Record supported sampling and the conservative catalog-profile policy that permits custom sampling only with provider_default/off. This policy does not encode every provider-supported sampling range.
Use official display names with alias/snapshot labels and per-model pricing provenance; existing input/output/cache-read rates remain unchanged.

limitations.reason: The native API supports low/medium/high effort together with a manual budget. Version 1 expresses one selected reasoning mode and cannot represent that combination. This profile selects off/budget; the omitted effort modes remain native capabilities.
The API still accepts deprecated manual thinking. This profile selects adaptive effort and off for these entries, with one serializer mode per record. Omitting manual budgets is a profile choice.

The API accepts top_p 0.95-1 with thinking for these model generations. Version 1 has no parameter-range representation, so the conservative profile excludes custom sampling with explicit thinking. Scalar false flags describe custom sampling support; consumers should treat explicit default values according to their request contract.
The native API rejects forced any/tool choice for these models. tools=true describes ordinary auto function calling; version 1 has no per-choice field. Consumers must validate tool choice separately.

Interleaved manual thinking requires beta header and can exceed max_tokens; not enabled by this catalog. Budget max63999 derives from ordinary max_tokens64000 minus1, not the optional interleaved path.

Native signed thinking can bind to the system/tools/history prefix. Static model metadata cannot ensure edited or compacted history remains valid; consumers must validate replay and context behavior separately.
Rates describe standard global token processing. Cache-write TTL, fast mode, regional inference, server tools and batch prices are separate; layer does not claim a universal invoice.

mapping.context_window: Use the CLI's context_window=272000, not its optional larger max_context_window, the 95% effective-context planning margin, or API model limits.
mapping.max_output_tokens: Unknown for every entry: absent from the reviewed Codex model metadata. API 128000 is not promoted to a subscription guarantee.
mapping.reasoning_budget: Unknown: the reviewed CLI model metadata supplies effort lists, not numeric reasoning budget limits.
mapping.sampling: supports_temperature=null and supports_top_p=null: the reviewed public model metadata does not establish support or rejection. Consumer transport restrictions are not provider evidence.
mapping.pricing: Always explicit null: subscription usage does not establish API per-token prices.
mapping.system_tools_streaming: Selected subscription profile supports system instructions, ordinary function calling and streaming. Public CLI metadata and official subscription documentation describe these workflows; this is metadata evidence, not a live endpoint test.
mapping.images: Known true from input_modalities containing image for each included exact model.
mapping.cli_tool_mode: code_mode_only is a Codex CLI orchestration preference, outside the model protocol and capability fields represented by this schema.

selection.rule: Exact visible IDs in the local current Codex model metadata, corroborated by the official current subscription model page.
selection.mode_policy: Intersect each exact model public CLI effort list with the version 1 catalog vocabulary. Do not convert ultra to max or infer none/off from API model documentation.
selection.default_policy: Keep provider_default; do not turn CLI default_reasoning_level into a request override.

catalog_profile.scope: Text input and streamed text output with ordinary function calling; image input is optional. This is a curated interoperable subset, not an exhaustive index of all provider products or parameters.
catalog_profile.schema: Version 1 stores one serializer profile per entry, scalar sampling support flags and one selected reasoning mode. It does not express parameter ranges or simultaneous effort and manual budget.

field_semantics.provider_fact: Values supported by the exact model/provider source.
field_semantics.profile_policy: A documented conservative subset selected for this schema. A restriction is not evidence that the provider rejects every omitted feature.
field_semantics.unknown: Null means the reviewed sources do not establish a value. A particular consumer restriction must not become a provider fact.

catalog_profile.consumer_responsibility: Apply serializer or product-specific restrictions after reading the catalog. This catalog does not select credentials, endpoints or user defaults.
